app.name: CivicPulse
app.tagline: Report and track problems in your city

status.offline: The city service can't be reached right now. Information on this page may be out of date.

map.title: City map
map.heading: City map
map.intro: Reported problems in your city will appear on this map, grouped by area as you zoom in.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.heading: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to report problems and follow the ones you reported.

register.title: Create an account
register.heading: Create an account
register.intro: You need an account to report a problem, so we can tell you when it is fixed.
register.displayNameHint: Shown to city staff on your reports
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few random words work well.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.heading: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.body: Your account doesn't have the role this page needs. Ask an administrator if you think it should.

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.heading: Users
adminUsers.selfHint: You can't remove your own admin role.

errors.email: Enter an email address like name@example.org
errors.password: Use at least 10 characters (no more than 72 bytes)
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect, or the account is locked for 15 minutes after too many attempts.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts from this device. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.CANNOT_REMOVE_OWN_ADMIN_ROLE: You can't remove the admin role from your own account.
errors.CANNOT_DISABLE_OWN_ACCOUNT: You can't disable your own account.
errors.UNKNOWN_TEAM: That team no longer exists. Reload the page and pick another.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The city service can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.UNEXPECTED_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
